timeline.summary: Vesuvius India Limited scheduled an Institutional Investors and Analyst Meet on May 7, 2026, at Kolkata from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹499.85 Cr (+3.7% YoY), net profit ₹55.85 Cr (-5.8% YoY).
Vesuvius India submitted voting results and scrutinizer report for its 35th AGM held on May 7, 2026.
Vesuvius India announced the merger of its RTA CB Management Services into MUFG Intime India effective May 8, 2026.
Vesuvius India hosted its institutional investor and analyst meet on May 7, 2026, discussing growth strategy, technology edge, and market share.
